name: @openagt/host-claude-web
description: Claude Code on the web as a host for a project's runs: a run there is a cloud session on claude.ai, created and answered through the Claude web bridge extension, which this package brings. A plugin kept per computer, off until switched on; "Run on" offers it beside this computer.

scripts.prepack: node -e "if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Pack and publish with pnpm: it replaces workspace:* with the real version, npm does not');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node ../../scripts/test-node.mjs && node --experimental-vm-modules extension/check.mjs && cd dashboard && vitest run
